comparison.objective: Separate media with a manual screen vs turn a multimeter selector to OFF.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual pouring, agitation, and support placement vs precise single rotary-control manipulation among adjacent features.
comparison.success_condition: ≥98% recovery, retained washers, no loss, released 3 s dwell vs dial at 115°±3°, valid on spindle, low motion for 2 s.
comparison.reason: A shallow selector rotation does not test bulk-material separation.
